title: [master] - Subscription Contract Price Update applies the lowest sales price across all Unit of Measure codes instead of respecting Unit-Specific Price List entries in Subscription Billing.
summary: Subscription Contract Price Update now correctly respects unit-specific price list entries when calculating prices instead of applying the lowest price across all units of measure.
key_points: Fixed price calculation to filter by the subscription's specific unit of measure
Updated CreateTempSalesLine and CreateTempPurchaseLine procedures to populate Unit of Measure Code
Ensured temporary sales/purchase lines pass the correct Unit of Measure for accurate price filtering
Added test coverage to validate unit-specific price list behavior
